parts.article_title: Customer reviews of cafes in the town of Artingly

paragraphs.text: A Coffee Dream
paragraphs.translation: 咖啡之梦

paragraphs.text: The decor of this cafe is great, but why don't the owners make it easier to queue up? There's so little space around the counter that everyone is squashed together when they order. I'd also recommend checking that there's somewhere to sit when you go in as it can get very crowded.
paragraphs.translation:
这家咖啡馆的装饰很棒，但店主为什么不把排队方式弄得更方便些呢？
柜台周围的空间非常小，以至于每个人点单时都挤在一起。
我还建议你进去时先看看是否有座位，因为这里可能会非常拥挤。

paragraphs.text: B Cafelingo
paragraphs.translation: B 卡菲林戈咖啡馆

paragraphs.text: Local media are right in saying that this cafe makes the best cup of coffee in town, but remember to take the time to appreciate the local artwork displayed on the walls around you while you're sipping your cappuccino.
paragraphs.translation:
当地媒体说得对，这家咖啡馆制作了镇上最好的咖啡，
但记得在品尝你的卡布奇诺时，花时间欣赏周围墙上展示的当地艺术品。

paragraphs.text: C Billy Ding's Cafe
paragraphs.translation: C 比利·丁的咖啡馆

paragraphs.text: As this cafe had been recommended by someone staying in our hotel, we decided to try it out. Despite being on the first floor, it was already crowded by ten in the morning, and it quickly became clear to us that this is a place that residents in the area use regularly. Fortunately, a family group left just as we arrived, and we were lucky enough to get a table overlooking the street. There we enjoyed some deliciouspancakes, which we washed down with the biggest 'small' coffee we've ever had!
paragraphs.translation:
由于这家咖啡馆是我们酒店的一位住客推荐的，我们决定去尝试一下。
尽管位于一楼，但早上十点就已经很拥挤，我们很快意识到这是当地居民常去的地方。
幸运的是，我们到达时刚好有一家人离开，我们幸运地找到了一张可以俯瞰街道的桌子。
在那里，我们享用了美味的薄饼，并用我们喝过的最大的“小杯”咖啡将它们送下肚！

paragraphs.text: D Drink in the Park
paragraphs.translation: D 公园饮咖

paragraphs.text: No one can deny that this coffee house is located in a beautiful setting. If the outside tables are full, you can simply take your cup of coffee over to one of the many park benches and enjoy it there, which is what we often do.
paragraphs.translation:
没有人能否认这家咖啡馆坐落在一个风景优美的环境中。
如果户外的桌子都坐满了，你可以直接把咖啡带到附近的公园长椅上享用，这也是我们经常做的事情。

paragraphs.text: E Chocolotta's
paragraphs.translation: E. 巧克力之店

paragraphs.text: We've been here several times and always order the same drinks and food. The last few times, however, we've noticed that the rolls have less filling and the coffee tastes watery. Perhaps the company is trying to cut costs, but this will only lead to customers going elsewhere.
paragraphs.translation:
我们来过这里好几次，总是点同样的饮品和食物。
然而最近几次，我们注意到面包卷的馅料变少了，咖啡尝起来也很淡。
也许这家公司试图削减成本，但这只会导致顾客去别的地方。

paragraphs.text: F Cafe Soloist

After a considerable search, we eventually found Cafe Soloist tucked away behind an organic grocery store. There was nothing outside to indicate that it was there, which would have been helpful! Once inside, we were presented with a menu that had more coffee options than we had ever seen before. Twenty minutes and a lot of discussion later, we finally decided what we wanted. We could then sit back and enjoy the happy chatter and welcoming atmosphere around us.
paragraphs.translation:
经过一番寻找，我们最终发现了隐藏在一家有机杂货店后面的Cafe Soloist咖啡馆。
外面没有任何迹象表明它在那里，如果能有指示标志就好了！
一进门，我们就看到了一份比以往见过的选择更多样的咖啡菜单。
经过二十分钟和一番热烈的讨论后，我们终于决定了要点什么。
然后我们可以放松地坐下来，享受周围愉快的交谈声和热情的氛围。
经过相当一番寻找，我们最终在一家有机食品杂货店后面发现了隐蔽的Cafe Soloist。
外面没有任何标识表明它在那儿——要是能有的话就方便多了！
一进门，我们就看到了一份菜单，上面有比我们以前见过的更多的咖啡选择。
二十分钟和大量讨论之后，我们终于决定好要点什么。
随后，我们可以放松地坐下，享受周围愉快的谈笑声和热情温馨的氛围。

paragraphs.text: Frog Valley development
paragraphs.translation: Frog Valley开发项目

paragraphs.text: Creating a better area to meet the needs of the local community
paragraphs.translation: 创建一个更好的区域以满足当地社区的需求

paragraphs.text: The proposal to develop the part of our city known as Frog Valley has now been passed to the local council for consideration and approval. In case you missed earlier newspaper reports, here briefly are some of the changes and improvements that are being planned for the site.
paragraphs.translation:
开发我们城市中被称为“青蛙谷”的区域的提案现已提交给当地议会进行审议和批准。
以防您错过了早前的报纸报道，以下是针对该场地规划的一些变更和改进的简要介绍。

paragraphs.text: An area of land in the south-east corner of Frog Valley has been allocated to the construction of a new primary school which, if building does go ahead, will accommodate 300 children. The size and location of the school mean that admission will not be limited to families who live in the area.
paragraphs.translation:
青蛙谷东南角的一片土地已被划拨用于建设一所新小学，若工程确实进行，该学校将容纳300名儿童。
这所学校的规模和位置意味着其入学资格将不仅限于居住在该地区的家庭。

paragraphs.text: Another feature that will bring people together will be the new shopping mall. Plans are to move all the existing local shops, which are currently located in small groups around the site, into one shopping zone, and this will see the addition of an organic farm shop and a vegan store.
paragraphs.translation:
另一个将促进人们聚集的特色是新的购物中心。
计划是将目前分散在该区域各处的所有现有本地商铺迁移至一个购物区，并且这将新增一家有机农场商店和一家素食店。

paragraphs.text: A community centre will be central to the development of the site. It will provide a much needed meeting place for clubs and societies that, until now, have had to meet wherever they can find a venue. The pride of the centre will be a multi-gym with swimming pool-something younger residents have been requesting for some time but that has never been possible, due to cost.
paragraphs.translation:
一个社区中心将成为该地块开发的核心。
它将为俱乐部和社团提供一个急需的聚会场所，而此前它们只能在能找到的任何地点进行活动。
该中心的骄傲将是一个带游泳池的多元健身馆——这是年轻居民一段时间以来一直要求的，但因成本问题此前从未实现过。

paragraphs.text: For many years now, local businesspeople have been asking for better business premises, and this is now a priority for Frog Valley. Twenty thousand square metres of space will be used to house anything from small startups to large existing local businesses. It will be built to the south-east of the site, with dedicated car parking for office workers, either within each office area or in a single car park.
paragraphs.translation:
多年来，当地商人一直在寻求更好的商业场所，而现在这已成为Frog Valley的一个优先事项。
两万平方米的空间将被用来容纳从初创小企业到现有的本地大型企业等各种类型的商业实体。
它将被建在场地东南侧，并为办公人员提供专用停车位，这些车位要么设在每个办公区域内，要么集中在一个停车场中。

paragraphs.text: At our public consultation meeting, some residents asked if it would be possible to include services such as dentistry and various types of medical testing facilities within the health centre. This would mean adding to the existing building and there are no plans to do this at present. However, it will be possible to see a doctor at weekends and in the evenings, which is a welcome development.
paragraphs.translation:
在我们的公众咨询会议上，一些居民询问是否可以在健康中心内纳入牙科和各类医疗检测设施等服务。
这意味着要对现有建筑进行扩建，而目前并无此计划。
不过，患者将可以在周末和晚上看医生，这是一个受欢迎的发展。

groups.instructions:

questions.reason: 直接对应题干'Cup sizes are more generous than you might expect'
questions.location_analysis: 原文描述'biggest small coffee we've ever had'，暗示咖啡杯...
questions.paraphrasing: Cup sizes are more generous -> the biggest 'small' coffee we've ever had
questions.keywords: Cup sizes, more generous, you might expect
evidence: There we enjoyed some deliciouspancakes, which we washed down with the biggest 'small' coffee we've ever had!

questions.prompt: Recent changes are likely to have a negative impact.
questions.analysis: 题干提到“Recent changes are likely to have a negative impact”，E段指出最近几次光顾时发现面包馅料减少、咖啡变淡，并推测公司可能在削减成本，这将导致顾客流失，明确表达了负面趋势，因此答案为E。
questions.reason: 质量下降和顾客流失暗示负面趋势

evidence: The last few times, however, we've noticed that the rolls have less filling and the coffee tastes watery.
Perhaps the company is trying to cut costs, but this will only lead to customers going elsewhere.

questions.prompt: It needs better signage for customers.
questions.analysis: 题干要求找出“需要更好的标识”的咖啡馆，F段提到“外面没有任何指示表明那里有咖啡馆”，说明缺乏外部招牌或指引，与题干中“better signage for customers”形成直接对应，因此答案为F。
questions.reason: 缺少标志导致难以找到
questions.location_analysis: 外面没有任何指示，需要更好的标识。
questions.paraphrasing: better signage -> nothing outside to indicate that it was there

questions.prompt: It has a strong local customer base.
questions.analysis: 题干中的“strong local customer base”在C段中有明确对应：“this is a place that residents in the area use regularly”，说明该咖啡馆深受当地居民欢迎，拥有稳固的本地客源，因此答案为C。
questions.reason: 直接说明当地顾客基础强
questions.location_analysis: 原文指出这是当地居民常去的地方。
questions.paraphrasing: strong local customer base -> a place that residents in the area use regularly
evidence: it quickly became clear to us that this is a place that residents in the area use regularly

questions.prompt: It deserves the public praise it has received.
questions.analysis: 题干“deserves the public praise it has received”与B段中“Local media are right in saying that this cafe makes the best cup of coffee in town”相呼应，表明该咖啡馆确实配得上媒体给予的好评，因此答案为B。
questions.reason: 直接对应公众赞誉
questions.location_analysis: 媒体称赞咖啡最好，符合应得公众赞誉。
questions.paraphrasing: deserves public praise -> right in saying that this cafe makes the best cup of coffee
evidence: Local media are right in saying that this cafe makes the best cup of coffee in town

groups.instructions:
Questions 6 - 14
Do the following statements agree with the information given in the text?
Choose TRUE if the statement agrees with the information given in the text, choose FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, or choose NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.

questions.prompt: Builders have already started work on the new primary school.
questions.analysis: 题干称“Builders have already started work on the new primary school”，但原文仅提到开发提案已提交议会审议，且使用了“if building does go ahead”的假设语气，说明尚未动工，与题干矛盾，故答案为FALSE。
questions.reason: 题干说已开工，原文说还在提案阶段，矛盾。
questions.location_analysis: 原文说提案刚通过，学校尚未动工，故为FALSE。
questions.paraphrasing: started work -> proposal passed, if building does go ahead
questions.keywords: builders, started work, new primary school
evidence: The proposal to develop the part of our city known as Frog Valley has now been passed to the local council for consideration and approval.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 原文明确表示建设工作尚未开始，该选项与原文信息矛盾。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文中已明确提及相关情况，并非未给出信息，因此该选项不成立。

questions.prompt: The new school will take in children from outside Frog Valley.
questions.analysis: 题干“new school will take in children from outside Frog Valley”对应原文“The size and location of the school mean that admission will not be limited to families who live in the area”，明确表示招生不限于本地家庭，因此答案为TRUE。
questions.reason: 直接对应招收区外学生
questions.location_analysis: 原文说不限于本地家庭，即招收区外儿童。
questions.paraphrasing: not limited to families in the area -> take in children from outside
evidence: The size and location of the school mean that admission will not be limited to families who live in the area.

wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文明确提到新学校会接收来自Frog Valley以外的孩子，与选项矛盾。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文已明确提及相关事实，并非未给出信息。

questions.prompt: There will be an increase in the number of shops.
questions.analysis: 题干询问商店数量是否会增加，原文提到将现有分散店铺集中，并新增一家有机农场店和一家纯素商店（“addition of an organic farm shop and a vegan store”），说明总数会增加，因此答案为TRUE。
questions.reason: 新增店铺意味着总数增加。
questions.location_analysis: 原文说将现有商店集中，并新增两个店，所以数量增加。
questions.paraphrasing: increase in number -> addition of an organic farm shop and a vegan store

wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文中明确提到了商店数量会增加，与选项矛盾。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文明确给出了商店数量增加的信息，并非未提及。

questions.prompt: The community centre will replace an existing social club building.
questions.analysis:
原文只说明：规划新建一座社区中心，给各类社团、俱乐部提供固定聚会场地；在此之前这些社团没有固定场地，只能随便找地方聚会。
全文完全没有出现 existing social club building（现成的社交俱乐部建筑）这个概念，没有提到原本存在一座俱乐部楼房；
也没有出现 replace（拆除、取代）相关动作描述，不存在 “用新社区中心替换旧俱乐部建筑” 的规划。
全文其他段落（小学、商场、办公区、医疗中心）全部排查完毕，均无相关内容。
questions.reason: 未提到替代现有俱乐部建筑
questions.location_analysis: 原文仅说明新建社区中心供各类社团使用，全文不存在 “现有社交俱乐部建筑” 以及 “社区中心将其取代” 的相关描述，信息文中未出现，答案 NOT GIVEN。
questions.paraphrasing: 无匹配替换，原文从未提到现有社交俱乐部建筑
questions.keywords: community centre, replace, existing social club building
evidence: A community centre will be central to the development of the site.

A community centre will be central to the development of the site. It will provide a much needed meeting place for clubs and societies that, until now, have had to meet wherever they can find a venue.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 全文没有说过原本有一座专门的 social club building，也没有 “replace 替换拆除旧建筑” 这个动作描述
wrong_reasons.FALSE: 本文通篇没有任何句子反驳 “存在旧俱乐部建筑”、也没有说 “社区中心不会取代它”，不存在任何冲突信息，没有证据证明题干是错的，因此不能选 FALSE。

questions.prompt: The swimming pool will be free for residents of Frog Valley.
questions.analysis: 题干声称游泳池对居民免费，但原文仅提到社区中心将设有多功能健身房和游泳池，未涉及费用或是否免费，因此文中无相关信息，答案为NOT GIVEN。
questions.reason: 题干说免费，原文无相关信息
questions.location_analysis: 原文提到游泳池但未提及费用或免费。
questions.paraphrasing: free for residents -> no mention of cost
evidence: The pride of the centre will be a multi-gym with swimming pool

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 原文未提及Frog Valley居民可免费使用游泳池的信息，属于无中生有。
wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文未明确表示游泳池对Frog Valley居民不免费，因此不能判断为错误。

questions.prompt: The office space will accommodate businesses of different sizes.
questions.analysis: 题干“office space will accommodate businesses of different sizes”与原文“house anything from small startups to large existing local businesses”完全对应，明确说明办公空间适用于不同规模企业，因此答案为TRUE。
questions.reason: 直接对应不同规模企业
questions.location_analysis: 原文明确包括从初创到大型企业，即不同规模。
questions.paraphrasing: different sizes -> small startups to large existing local businesses
evidence: Twenty thousand square metres of space will be used to house anything from small startups to large existing local businesses.

wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文明确说明办公空间可以容纳不同规模的企业，与题干一致。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文中已明确提及相关内容，并非未给出。

questions.prompt: The business car parking area will be underground.
questions.analysis: 题干称商务停车场“will be underground”，但原文仅说明停车位“within each office area or in a single car park”，未提及是否位于地下，因此信息未给出，答案为NOT GIVEN。
questions.reason: 题干说地下停车，原文无此信息
questions.location_analysis: 原文提到停车在办公区内或单独停车场，但未说明是地下。
questions.paraphrasing: underground -> with dedicated car parking for office workers, either within each office area or in a single car park
evidence: It will be built to the south-east of the site, with dedicated car parking for office workers, either within each office area or in a single car park.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 原文未提及商业停车场的位置，无法判断为真，属于无中生有。
wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文未提及商业停车场的位置，无法判断为假，属于无中生有。

questions.prompt: The health centre will offer a wide range of new services.
questions.analysis: 题干称健康中心将提供“a wide range of new services”，但原文明确表示目前“no plans to do this at present”来增加牙科或检测等服务，与题干矛盾，故答案为FALSE。
questions.reason: 明确表示不增加新服务
questions.location_analysis: 原文说目前无计划增加牙科和检测等服务，与题干矛盾。
questions.paraphrasing: wide range of new services -> include dentistry and various types of medical testing (but no plans)
questions.keywords: health centre, wide range, new services
evidence: This would mean adding to the existing building and there are no plans to do this at present.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 选项内容与原文信息矛盾，原文并未提供如此广泛的新服务。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文未明确说明健康中心是否会提供广泛的新服务。

questions.prompt: At present, there are too few doctors at the health centre.
questions.analysis: 题干称“too few doctors at the health centre”，但原文只提到未来可在周末和晚上看医生，未涉及当前医生数量是否不足，因此文中无相关信息，答案为NOT GIVEN。
questions.reason: 题干说医生数量少，原文无相关信息
questions.location_analysis: 原文提到可周末和晚上看医生，但未提及医生数量是否不足。
questions.paraphrasing: too few doctors -> no information on doctor numbers
questions.keywords: too few doctors, health centre, present
evidence: it will be possible to see a doctor at weekends and in the evenings, which is a welcome development.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 原文未提及目前健康中心医生数量是否太少，因此无法判断该说法正确。
wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文没有提供任何关于医生数量的信息，无法确定该说法为错误。

sentence_translations.sentence: Fortunately, a family group left just as we arrived, and we were lucky enough to get a table overlooking the street.
sentence_translations.translation: 幸运的是，我们到达时刚好有一家人离开，我们幸运地找到了一张可以俯瞰街道的桌子。

sentence_translations.sentence: There we enjoyed some deliciouspancakes, which we washed down with the biggest 'small' coffee we've ever had!
sentence_translations.translation: 在那里，我们享用了美味的薄饼，并用我们喝过的最大的“小杯”咖啡将它们送下肚！

sentence_translations.sentence: D Drink in the Park
sentence_translations.translation: D 公园饮咖

sentence_translations.sentence: No one can deny that this coffee house is located in a beautiful setting.
sentence_translations.translation: 没有人能否认这家咖啡馆坐落在一个风景优美的环境中。

sentence_translations.sentence: If the outside tables are full, you can simply take your cup of coffee over to one of the many park benches and enjoy it there, which is what we often do.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果户外的桌子都坐满了，你可以直接把咖啡带到附近的公园长椅上享用，这也是我们经常做的事情。

sentence_translations.sentence: E Chocolotta's
sentence_translations.translation: E. 巧克力之店

sentence_translations.sentence: We've been here several times and always order the same drinks and food.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们来过这里好几次，总是点同样的饮品和食物。

sentence_translations.sentence: The last few times, however, we've noticed that the rolls have less filling and the coffee tastes watery.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而最近几次，我们注意到面包卷的馅料变少了，咖啡尝起来也很淡。

sentence_translations.sentence: Perhaps the company is trying to cut costs, but this will only lead to customers going elsewhere.
sentence_translations.translation: 也许这家公司试图削减成本，但这只会导致顾客去别的地方。

sentence_translations.sentence: After a considerable search, we eventually found Cafe Soloist tucked away behind an organic grocery store.
sentence_translations.translation: 经过一番寻找，我们最终发现了隐藏在一家有机杂货店后面的Cafe Soloist咖啡馆。

sentence_translations.sentence: There was nothing outside to indicate that it was there, which would have been helpful!
sentence_translations.translation: 外面没有任何迹象表明它在那里，如果能有指示标志就好了！

sentence_translations.sentence: Once inside, we were presented with a menu that had more coffee options than we had ever seen before.
sentence_translations.translation: 一进门，我们就看到了一份比以往见过的选择更多样的咖啡菜单。

sentence_translations.sentence: Twenty minutes and a lot of discussion later, we finally decided what we wanted.
sentence_translations.translation: 经过二十分钟和一番热烈的讨论后，我们终于决定了要点什么。

sentence_translations.sentence: We could then sit back and enjoy the happy chatter and welcoming atmosphere around us.
sentence_translations.translation: 然后我们可以放松地坐下来，享受周围愉快的交谈声和热情的氛围。

sentence_translations.sentence: After a considerable search, we eventually found Cafe Soloist tucked away behind an organic grocery store.
sentence_translations.translation: 经过相当一番寻找，我们最终在一家有机食品杂货店后面发现了隐蔽的Cafe Soloist。

sentence_translations.sentence: There was nothing outside to indicate that it was there, which would have been helpful!
sentence_translations.translation: 外面没有任何标识表明它在那儿——要是能有的话就方便多了！

sentence_translations.sentence: Once inside, we were presented with a menu that had more coffee options than we had ever seen before.
sentence_translations.translation: 一进门，我们就看到了一份菜单，上面有比我们以前见过的更多的咖啡选择。

sentence_translations.sentence: Twenty minutes and a lot of discussion later, we finally decided what we wanted.
sentence_translations.translation: 二十分钟和大量讨论之后，我们终于决定好要点什么。

sentence_translations.sentence: We could then sit back and enjoy the happy chatter and welcoming atmosphere around us.
sentence_translations.translation: 随后，我们可以放松地坐下，享受周围愉快的谈笑声和热情温馨的氛围。

sentence_translations.sentence: Frog Valley development
sentence_translations.translation: Frog Valley开发项目

sentence_translations.sentence: Creating a better area to meet the needs of the local community
sentence_translations.translation: 创建一个更好的区域以满足当地社区的需求

sentence_translations.sentence: The proposal to develop the part of our city known as Frog Valley has now been passed to the local council for consideration and approval.
sentence_translations.translation: 开发我们城市中被称为“青蛙谷”的区域的提案现已提交给当地议会进行审议和批准。

sentence_translations.sentence: In case you missed earlier newspaper reports, here briefly are some of the changes and improvements that are being planned for the site.
sentence_translations.translation: 以防您错过了早前的报纸报道，以下是针对该场地规划的一些变更和改进的简要介绍。

sentence_translations.sentence: An area of land in the south-east corner of Frog Valley has been allocated to the construction of a new primary school which, if building does go ahead, will accommodate 300 children.
sentence_translations.translation: 青蛙谷东南角的一片土地已被划拨用于建设一所新小学，若工程确实进行，该学校将容纳300名儿童。

sentence_translations.sentence: The size and location of the school mean that admission will not be limited to families who live in the area.
sentence_translations.translation: 这所学校的规模和位置意味着其入学资格将不仅限于居住在该地区的家庭。

sentence_translations.sentence: Another feature that will bring people together will be the new shopping mall.
sentence_translations.translation: 另一个将促进人们聚集的特色是新的购物中心。

sentence_translations.sentence: Plans are to move all the existing local shops, which are currently located in small groups around the site, into one shopping zone, and this will see the addition of an organic farm shop and a vegan store.
sentence_translations.translation: 计划是将目前分散在该区域各处的所有现有本地商铺迁移至一个购物区，并且这将新增一家有机农场商店和一家素食店。

sentence_translations.sentence: A community centre will be central to the development of the site.
sentence_translations.translation: 一个社区中心将成为该地块开发的核心。

sentence_translations.sentence: It will provide a much needed meeting place for clubs and societies that, until now, have had to meet wherever they can find a venue.
sentence_translations.translation: 它将为俱乐部和社团提供一个急需的聚会场所，而此前它们只能在能找到的任何地点进行活动。

sentence_translations.sentence: The pride of the centre will be a multi-gym with swimming pool - something younger residents have been requesting for some time but that has never been possible, due to cost.
sentence_translations.translation: 该中心的骄傲将是一个带游泳池的多元健身馆——这是年轻居民一段时间以来一直要求的，但因成本问题此前从未实现过。

sentence_translations.sentence: For many years now, local businesspeople have been asking for better business premises, and this is now a priority for Frog Valley.
sentence_translations.translation: 多年来，当地商人一直在寻求更好的商业场所，而现在这已成为Frog Valley的一个优先事项。

sentence_translations.sentence: Twenty thousand square metres of space will be used to house anything from small startups to large existing local businesses.
sentence_translations.translation: 两万平方米的空间将被用来容纳从初创小企业到现有的本地大型企业等各种类型的商业实体。

sentence_translations.sentence: It will be built to the south-east of the site, with dedicated car parking for office workers, either within each office area or in a single car park.
sentence_translations.translation: 它将被建在场地东南侧，并为办公人员提供专用停车位，这些车位要么设在每个办公区域内，要么集中在一个停车场中。

sentence_translations.sentence: At our public consultation meeting, some residents asked if it would be possible to include services such as dentistry and various types of medical testing facilities within the health centre.
sentence_translations.translation: 在我们的公众咨询会议上，一些居民询问是否可以在健康中心内纳入牙科和各类医疗检测设施等服务。

sentence_translations.sentence: This would mean adding to the existing building and there are no plans to do this at present.
sentence_translations.translation: 这意味着要对现有建筑进行扩建，而目前并无此计划。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, it will be possible to see a doctor at weekends and in the evenings, which is a welcome development.
sentence_translations.translation: 不过，患者将可以在周末和晚上看医生，这是一个受欢迎的发展。

paragraphs.text: Welcome to the Percil Training Institute. We hope that you will enjoy your course of training with us. This information is provided to introduce our Institute and to let you know some of the important features of our professional training courses.
paragraphs.translation:
欢迎来到珀西尔培训学院。
我们希望您能享受与我们一同进行的培训课程。
提供此信息是为了介绍我们的学院，并让您了解我们专业培训课程的一些重要特点。
课程

paragraphs.text: Courses
paragraphs.translation: 课程

paragraphs.text: Percil Training Institute was established to provide high quality short-duration training programmes for a range of professional needs. It has a highly trained and experienced teaching staff, many of whom have taught overseas.
paragraphs.translation:
珀西尔培训学院的成立旨在为一系列专业需求提供高质量的短期培训课程。
它拥有一支训练有素且经验丰富的教学团队，其中许多成员曾在海外任教。

paragraphs.text: Percil Training Institute provides courses in ten-week modules. Most courses (e.g. Office Management, Librarianship, Medical Records Organisation) consist of two modules, although some courses (Biotechnology, Computer Analysis) are three or four modules long. There is a break of two weeks between each module but since projects or assignments are set for completion in these periods, it is not possible to take vacations during this time.
paragraphs.translation:
课程
珀西尔培训学院提供的课程以十周为一个模块。
大多数课程（例如办公室管理、图书馆学、医疗档案组织）由两个模块组成，尽管有些课程（生物技术、计算机分析）长达三个或四个模块。
每个模块之间有两周的休息时间，但由于项目或作业需要在此期间完成，因此在此期间不可能休假。

paragraphs.text: Since each course has varying needs, there are not necessarily any set hours for classes across all programmes. You will need to consult the timetable for your course, which is printed at the front of your own course manual.
paragraphs.translation:
由于每门课程都有不同的需求，并非所有课程项目都有固定的上课时间。
你需要查阅课程的时间表，该时间表印刷在你自己的课程手册的首页。

paragraphs.text: Please be reminded that Percil Training Institute cannot provide attendance or achievement certificates for students who have missed part of their course as a result of not reading their own course timetables properly. Legitimate reasons for non-attendance (e.g.illness) will be given consideration provided that documentary evidence is provided. In this case, an achievement certificate only will be issued.
paragraphs.translation:
请谨记，珀西尔培训学院无法为因未仔细阅读个人课程时间表而缺课的学生提供出勤或成绩证书。
对于缺课的正当理由（例如生病），只要提供书面证据，将予以考虑。
在这种情况下，仅会颁发一份成绩证书。

paragraphs.text: Facilities
paragraphs.translation: 设施

paragraphs.text: The opening times of the snack bar, coffee lounge and restaurant are printed below your course timetable. No bookings are required for any of the eating places except the restaurant for Friday and Saturday dinner. The coffee lounge and restaurant are not normally open on public holidays. However, a group booking may be made for the restaurant for dinner on such days, provided that there is a minimum of 20 people in the group. A non-refundable deposit will be required for such a booking.
paragraphs.translation:
小吃吧、咖啡厅和餐厅的开放时间印在你的课程时间表下方。
除餐厅的周五和周六晚餐外，所有餐饮场所均无需预订。
咖啡厅和餐厅通常在公共假日不营业。
然而，在这些日子，如果团体人数至少达到20人，可以预订餐厅的晚餐。
此类预订需要支付不可退还的押金。

paragraphs.text: The Institute has a very fine sports complex. The swimming pool is open daily from 8.00 am to 8.00 pm and can be used free of charge by all Percil students who present a valid student enrolment card. The squash courts can be booked by any student with a valid student card and the hire cost is $4.50 per half hour. The gymnasium is available for a ten-week membership fee of $40.00, or $5.00 per visit, or an annual subscription of $100. Guests of Percil students are welcome to use the swimming pool but not the gymnasium areas.
paragraphs.translation:
该学院拥有一个非常出色的体育综合设施。
游泳池每天上午8点至晚上8点开放，所有持有有效学生注册卡的珀西尔学生均可免费使用。
任何持有有效学生卡的学生均可预订壁球场，租赁费用为每半小时4.50美元。
体育馆可供使用，十周会员费为40.00美元，或每次访问5.00美元，或年费100美元。
珀西尔学生的客人欢迎使用游泳池，但不得使用体育馆区域。

paragraphs.text: Security
paragraphs.translation: 安全

paragraphs.text: Please be careful that you do not leave valuable items in the classroom areas at any time. Percil Training Institute cannot be held responsible for any loss or damage to students' property as a result of student negligence. After 8.30 pm the front doors of the Institute are locked. If you need to gain access to the Institute after this time, please contact the caretaker by pressing the doorbell and speaking through the intercom. If you are admitted by the caretaker you will be required to show your student card.
paragraphs.translation:
请务必注意，任何时候都不要将贵重物品留在教室区域内。
珀西尔培训学院不对因学生疏忽导致的任何财产损失或损害承担责任。
晚上8点30分后，学院的前门会被锁上。
如果您在此时间后需要进入学院，请按门铃并通过对讲机与管理员联系。
如果管理员允许您进入，您将被要求出示学生证。

paragraphs.text: Medical Care
paragraphs.translation: 医疗保健

paragraphs.text: Minor accidents and injuries can usually be attended to on the premises, in the Health Centre on the third floor. These services are free. Headache pills and other analgesics are available at standard pharmacy prices.
paragraphs.translation:
轻微的意外事故和受伤通常可以在大楼内的三楼健康中心得到处理。
这些服务是免费的。
头痛药和其他止痛药按标准药房价格提供。

paragraphs.text: Percil Memorial Training Scholarships
paragraphs.translation: 珀西尔纪念培训奖学金

paragraphs.text: (3 offered per year)
paragraphs.translation: （每年提供3个名额）

paragraphs.text: Percil Training Institute offers a number of scholarships for people from overseas who plan to live in Australia and need re-training. These scholarships are available for full-time study only and are not offered for courses of less than 20 weeks' duration.
paragraphs.translation:
课程
佩西尔培训学院为计划在澳大利亚居住并需要再培训的海外人士提供多项奖学金。
这些奖学金仅适用于全日制学习，且不提供给时长少于20周的课程。

paragraphs.text: Requirements/eligibility
paragraphs.translation: 要求/资格条件

paragraphs.text: Applicants for these scholarships must be of high academic ability as revealed in the qualifications they have already gained in their home country; alternatively, they must have at least five years of significant work experience in their chosen field and must produce evidence in the form of references from at least two employers or supervisors.
paragraphs.translation:
这些奖学金的申请人必须具备较高的学术能力，这一点可以通过其在原籍国已经获得的学历证明体现；
或者，他们必须在其所选领域拥有至少五年的重要工作经验，并且必须提供至少两名雇主或主管的推荐信作为证明。

paragraphs.text: The award
paragraphs.translation: 奖项

paragraphs.text: These scholarships offer return airfares to Australia from your home country, provided that the distance by air from your city of departure to Sydney is not more than 2,500 kilometres. If the distance exceeds this amount, you will be provided with airline vouchers. Travel expenses to and from airports on both the outward and return journeys are paid for, and there is an airline excess baggage allowance of 120 kg.
paragraphs.translation:
这些奖学金提供从您的祖国前往澳大利亚的往返机票，前提是您出发城市到悉尼的空中距离不超过2500公里。
如果距离超过此数值，您将获得航空代金券。
去程和返程的机场往返交通费用由奖学金支付，并且提供120公斤的航空超重行李限额。

paragraphs.text: Personal removal expenses for scholarship holders are not paid. If the scholarship holder is married at the time of applying for the scholarship, some travel and removal costs may be paid for the husband or wife. Travel costs or support for dependent children are at the scholarship holder's expense.
paragraphs.translation:
奖学金获得者的个人搬迁费用不予支付。
如果奖学金申请者在申请时是已婚状态，部分差旅和搬迁费用可以为其配偶支付。
受抚养子女的差旅费用或资助由奖学金获得者自行承担。

paragraphs.text: Scholars are eligible for assistance with accommodation within the Sydney metropolitan area, although married accommodation is unavailable on the Percil Institute campus. Since demand for accommodation on the campus is always high, scholarship applicants are advised to apply at least ten weeks before intending to come into residence.
paragraphs.translation:
学者有资格在悉尼市区范围内获得住宿方面的帮助，尽管珀西尔学院校园内不提供已婚人士的住宿。
由于校园内的住宿需求一直很高，建议奖学金申请者在计划入住前至少十周提出申请。

groups.instructions:
Questions 15 - 24
Do the following statements agree with the information given in the text?
Choose TRUE if the statement agrees with the information given in the text, choose FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, or choose NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.

questions.prompt: All of the staff have overseas teaching experience.
questions.analysis: 题干中的“All of the staff”与原文中的“many of whom have taught overseas”形成对比。原文明确指出只有“many”（许多）教职员工有海外教学经验，而非“all”（全部），因此该陈述与原文信息矛盾，正确答案为FALSE。
questions.reason: 原文明确many而非all，与题干矛盾。
questions.location_analysis: 原文说many有海外教学经验，并非all，故选FALSE。
questions.paraphrasing: All of the staff -> many of whom; overseas teaching experience -> have taught overseas
evidence: It has a highly trained and experienced teaching staff, many of whom have taught overseas.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 该选项与原文信息矛盾，原文明确表明并非所有员工都有海外教学经验。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文已提供了相关信息，可以判断该说法错误，并非未提及。

questions.prompt: All modules are of equal length.
questions.analysis: 原文提到“Percil Training Institute provides courses in ten-week modules”，说明所有课程模块均为十周长度，即每个模块时长相等。因此题干“All modules are of equal length”与原文一致，正确答案为TRUE。
questions.reason: 模块长度统一为ten-week，推断所有模块等长。
questions.location_analysis: 原文明确所有课程由ten-week modules组成，即每个模块长度相同，故选TRUE。
questions.paraphrasing: all modules -> ten-week modules; equal length -> each module is ten weeks
evidence: Percil Training Institute provides courses in ten-week modules.

wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文明确表示所有模块长度相等，与选项矛盾。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文明确给出了模块长度相等的信息，并非未提及。

questions.prompt: Students are encouraged to take holidays in the two-week breaks between modules.
questions.analysis: 题干称学生被鼓励在模块间的两周休息时间度假，但原文明确指出“it is not possible to take vacations during this time”，因为这段时间需完成项目或作业。因此该陈述与原文矛盾，正确答案为FALSE。
questions.reason: 原文直接说明不能休假。
questions.location_analysis: 原文明确说不能在这些休息时间度假，故选FALSE。
questions.paraphrasing: take holidays -> take vacations; two-week breaks -> break of two weeks between each module
evidence: There is a break of two weeks between each module but since projects or assignments are set for completion in these periods, it is not possible to take vacations during this time.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 与原文信息矛盾，原文指出学校不鼓励在模块间假期休假。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文明确提及了相关内容，并非未给出信息。

questions.prompt: Courses may have very different timetables.
questions.analysis: 原文指出“Since each course has varying needs, there are not necessarily any set hours for classes across all programmes”，说明不同课程的课表安排可能差异很大，学生需查阅各自课程手册中的时间表。因此题干“Courses may have very different timetables”符合原文，正确答案为TRUE。
questions.reason: 课程需求不同，课表可能不同。
questions.location_analysis: 原文指出不同课程没有固定时间，需查各自课表，说明课表可能不同，故选TRUE。
questions.paraphrasing: different timetables -> not necessarily any set hours for classes across all programmes; timetables -> timetable for your course
evidence: Since each course has varying needs, there are not necessarily any set hours for classes across all programmes. You will need to consult the timetable for your course, which is printed at the front of your own course manual.

wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文中明确提到了课程时间表可能有很大差异，与题干一致，因此FALSE选项错误。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 题干内容在原文中有直接对应的信息，并非未提及，因此NOT GIVEN选项错误。

questions.prompt: You can still obtain an attendance certificate if you have been absent through illness.
questions.analysis: 题干询问因病缺席是否仍可获得出勤证明（attendance certificate），但原文说明即使因病缺勤且提供证明，也“only will be issued”成就证书（achievement certificate），并未提及出勤证明。因此该陈述与原文不符，正确答案为FALSE。
questions.reason: 生病只能获得achievement certificate而非attendance certificate。
questions.location_analysis: 原文说可考虑生病缺席，但只发achievement certificate而非attendan...
questions.paraphrasing: attendance certificate -> attendance or achievement certificates; absent through illness -> legitimate reasons for non-attendance (e.g. illness)
evidence: Legitimate reasons for non-attendance (e.g.illness) will be given consideration provided that documentary evidence is provided. In this case, an achievement certificate only will be issued.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 与原文矛盾，原文明确表示因病缺席不能获得出勤证书。

sentence_translations.sentence: Welcome to the Percil Training Institute.
sentence_translations.translation: 欢迎来到珀西尔培训学院。

sentence_translations.sentence: We hope that you will enjoy your course of training with us.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们希望您能享受与我们一同进行的培训课程。

sentence_translations.sentence: This information is provided to introduce our Institute and to let you know some of the important features of our professional training courses.
sentence_translations.translation: 提供此信息是为了介绍我们的学院，并让您了解我们专业培训课程的一些重要特点。

sentence_translations.sentence: Courses
sentence_translations.translation: 课程

sentence_translations.sentence: Percil Training Institute was established to provide high quality short-duration training programmes for a range of professional needs.
sentence_translations.translation: 珀西尔培训学院的成立旨在为一系列专业需求提供高质量的短期培训课程。

sentence_translations.sentence: It has a highly trained and experienced teaching staff, many of whom have taught overseas.
sentence_translations.translation: 它拥有一支训练有素且经验丰富的教学团队，其中许多成员曾在海外任教。

sentence_translations.sentence: Percil Training Institute provides courses in ten-week modules.
sentence_translations.translation: 珀西尔培训学院提供的课程以十周为一个模块。

sentence_translations.sentence: Most courses (e.g. Office Management, Librarianship, Medical Records Organisation) consist of two modules, although some courses (Biotechnology, Computer Analysis) are three or four modules long.
sentence_translations.translation: 大多数课程（例如办公室管理、图书馆学、医疗档案组织）由两个模块组成，尽管有些课程（生物技术、计算机分析）长达三个或四个模块。

sentence_translations.sentence: There is a break of two weeks between each module but since projects or assignments are set for completion in these periods, it is not possible to take vacations during this time.
sentence_translations.translation: 每个模块之间有两周的休息时间，但由于项目或作业需要在此期间完成，因此在此期间不可能休假。

sentence_translations.sentence: Since each course has varying needs, there are not necessarily any set hours for classes across all programmes.
sentence_translations.translation: 由于每门课程都有不同的需求，并非所有课程项目都有固定的上课时间。

sentence_translations.sentence: You will need to consult the timetable for your course, which is printed at the front of your own course manual.
sentence_translations.translation: 你需要查阅课程的时间表，该时间表印刷在你自己的课程手册的首页。

sentence_translations.sentence: Please be reminded that Percil Training Institute cannot provide attendance or achievement certificates for students who have missed part of their course as a result of not reading their own course timetables properly.
sentence_translations.translation: 请谨记，珀西尔培训学院无法为因未仔细阅读个人课程时间表而缺课的学生提供出勤或成绩证书。

sentence_translations.sentence: Legitimate reasons for non-attendance (e.g.illness) will be given consideration provided that documentary evidence is provided.
sentence_translations.translation: 对于缺课的正当理由（例如生病），只要提供书面证据，将予以考虑。

sentence_translations.sentence: In this case, an achievement certificate only will be issued.
sentence_translations.translation: 在这种情况下，仅会颁发一份成绩证书。

sentence_translations.sentence: Facilities
sentence_translations.translation: 设施

sentence_translations.sentence: The opening times of the snack bar, coffee lounge and restaurant are printed below your course timetable.
sentence_translations.translation: 小吃吧、咖啡厅和餐厅的开放时间印在你的课程时间表下方。

sentence_translations.sentence: No bookings are required for any of the eating places except the restaurant for Friday and Saturday dinner.
sentence_translations.translation: 除餐厅的周五和周六晚餐外，所有餐饮场所均无需预订。

sentence_translations.sentence: The coffee lounge and restaurant are not normally open on public holidays.
sentence_translations.translation: 咖啡厅和餐厅通常在公共假日不营业。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, a group booking may be made for the restaurant for dinner on such days, provided that there is a minimum of 20 people in the group.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，在这些日子，如果团体人数至少达到20人，可以预订餐厅的晚餐。

sentence_translations.sentence: A non-refundable deposit will be required for such a booking.
sentence_translations.translation: 此类预订需要支付不可退还的押金。

sentence_translations.sentence: The Institute has a very fine sports complex.
sentence_translations.translation: 该学院拥有一个非常出色的体育综合设施。

sentence_translations.sentence: The swimming pool is open daily from 8.00 am to 8.00 pm and can be used free of charge by all Percil students who present a valid student enrolment card.
sentence_translations.translation: 游泳池每天上午8点至晚上8点开放，所有持有有效学生注册卡的珀西尔学生均可免费使用。

sentence_translations.sentence: The squash courts can be booked by any student with a valid student card and the hire cost is $4.50 per half hour.
sentence_translations.translation: 任何持有有效学生卡的学生均可预订壁球场，租赁费用为每半小时4.50美元。

sentence_translations.sentence: The gymnasium is available for a ten-week membership fee of $40.00, or $5.00 per visit, or an annual subscription of $100.
sentence_translations.translation: 体育馆可供使用，十周会员费为40.00美元，或每次访问5.00美元，或年费100美元。

sentence_translations.sentence: Guests of Percil students are welcome to use the swimming pool but not the gymnasium areas.
sentence_translations.translation: 珀西尔学生的客人欢迎使用游泳池，但不得使用体育馆区域。

sentence_translations.sentence: Security
sentence_translations.translation: 安全

sentence_translations.sentence: Please be careful that you do not leave valuable items in the classroom areas at any time.
sentence_translations.translation: 请务必注意，任何时候都不要将贵重物品留在教室区域内。

sentence_translations.sentence: Percil Training Institute cannot be held responsible for any loss or damage to students' property as a result of student negligence.
sentence_translations.translation: 珀西尔培训学院不对因学生疏忽导致的任何财产损失或损害承担责任。

sentence_translations.sentence: After 8.30 pm the front doors of the Institute are locked.
sentence_translations.translation: 晚上8点30分后，学院的前门会被锁上。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you need to gain access to the Institute after this time, please contact the caretaker by pressing the doorbell and speaking through the intercom.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果您在此时间后需要进入学院，请按门铃并通过对讲机与管理员联系。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you are admitted by the caretaker you will be required to show your student card.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果管理员允许您进入，您将被要求出示学生证。

sentence_translations.sentence: Medical Care
sentence_translations.translation: 医疗保健

sentence_translations.sentence: Minor accidents and injuries can usually be attended to on the premises, in the Health Centre on the third floor.
sentence_translations.translation: 轻微的意外事故和受伤通常可以在大楼内的三楼健康中心得到处理。

sentence_translations.sentence: These services are free.
sentence_translations.translation: 这些服务是免费的。

sentence_translations.sentence: Headache pills and other analgesics are available at standard pharmacy prices.
sentence_translations.translation: 头痛药和其他止痛药按标准药房价格提供。

sentence_translations.sentence: Percil Memorial Training Scholarships
sentence_translations.translation: 珀西尔纪念培训奖学金

sentence_translations.sentence: (3 offered per year)
sentence_translations.translation: （每年提供3个名额）

sentence_translations.sentence: Percil Training Institute offers a number of scholarships for people from overseas who plan to live in Australia and need re-training.
sentence_translations.translation: 佩西尔培训学院为计划在澳大利亚居住并需要再培训的海外人士提供多项奖学金。

sentence_translations.sentence: These scholarships are available for full-time study only and are not offered for courses of less than 20 weeks' duration.
sentence_translations.translation: 这些奖学金仅适用于全日制学习，且不提供给时长少于20周的课程。

sentence_translations.sentence: Requirements/eligibility
sentence_translations.translation: 要求/资格条件

sentence_translations.sentence: Applicants for these scholarships must be of high academic ability as revealed in the qualifications they have already gained in their home country;
sentence_translations.translation: 这些奖学金的申请人必须具备较高的学术能力，这一点可以通过其在原籍国已经获得的学历证明体现；

sentence_translations.sentence: alternatively, they must have at least five years of significant work experience in their chosen field and must produce evidence in the form of references from at least two employers or supervisors.

sentence_translations.sentence: The award
sentence_translations.translation: 奖项

sentence_translations.sentence: These scholarships offer return airfares to Australia from your home country, provided that the distance by air from your city of departure to Sydney is not more than 2,500 kilometres.
sentence_translations.translation: 这些奖学金提供从您的祖国前往澳大利亚的往返机票，前提是您出发城市到悉尼的空中距离不超过2500公里。

sentence_translations.sentence: If the distance exceeds this amount, you will be provided with airline vouchers.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果距离超过此数值，您将获得航空代金券。

sentence_translations.sentence: Travel expenses to and from airports on both the outward and return journeys are paid for, and there is an airline excess baggage allowance of 120 kg.
sentence_translations.translation: 去程和返程的机场往返交通费用由奖学金支付，并且提供120公斤的航空超重行李限额。

sentence_translations.sentence: Personal removal expenses for scholarship holders are not paid.

sentence_translations.sentence: If the scholarship holder is married at the time of applying for the scholarship, some travel and removal costs may be paid for the husband or wife.

sentence_translations.sentence: Travel costs or support for dependent children are at the scholarship holder's expense.

sentence_translations.sentence: Scholars are eligible for assistance with accommodation within the Sydney metropolitan area, although married accommodation is unavailable on the Percil Institute campus.

parts.title: Passage 3
parts.article_title: Divided opinions about letting farmland return to its natural state

paragraphs.text: Close to London's Gatwick Airport is Knepp Castle Estate, owned by Charlie Burrell. It is an intensive 3,500-acre farm that has been 'rewilded', that is, allowed to return to its natural, uncultivated state. After barely a decade, nature has come back astonishingly quickly. Neat fields of maize have been replaced with a landscape that resembles the typical grasslands of Africa. The original narrow clipped hedges that edged the farmland are now eight metres wide, and deer race through ragwort, thistles and other weeds in the meadows. The estate boasts more of the unusual purple emperor butterflies than anywhere else in Britain. It's also thought to be the only place where Britain's fastest-declining birds, turtle doves, are multiplying. But as rewilding blossoms, so do controversies.
paragraphs.translation:
靠近伦敦盖特威克机场的是查理·伯勒尔拥有的克内普城堡庄园。
这是一个占地3500英亩的精耕细作农场，已被‘再野化’，即允许其回归自然、未经耕作的状态。
仅仅不到十年，大自然以惊人的速度恢复了过来。
整齐的玉米田已被一片类似于非洲典型草原的景观所取代。
原本环绕农田的狭窄修剪树篱现在宽达八米，鹿群在草地上的狗舌草、蓟草和其他杂草间疾驰。
这座庄园拥有的罕见紫蛱蝶数量比英国任何其他地方都多。
它也被认为是英国数量下降最快的鸟类——斑尾林鸽——唯一在繁衍的地方。
但随着再野化的蓬勃发展，争议也随之而来。

paragraphs.text: In Wales, one ecologist says the concept can't even be mentioned to farmers. Even the harmless beaver is the subject of fierce debate: while it was recognised as a native animal in Scotland last year, beavers reintroduced in south-west England roam free only on a government trial.'For us it is strange to see the British struggling with the beaver. Come on, we have thousands of them!'Dutch ecologist Leo Linnartz told a rewilding conference. Linnartz says that many Dutch objected to 'nature development' 30 years ago but rewilding principles are now mainstream.
paragraphs.translation:
在威尔士，一位生态学家表示，甚至连向农民提及这个概念都不行。
甚至无害的海狸也成为激烈争论的主题：尽管去年它在苏格兰被认定为本土动物，但在英格兰西南部重新引入的海狸仅在政府试验项目下自由活动。
“对我们来说，看到英国人与海狸斗争很奇怪。拜托，我们有成千上万只！”荷兰生态学家Leo Linnartz在一次自然恢复会议上说道。
Linnartz表示，30年前许多荷兰人反对“自然开发”，但现在自然恢复原则已成为主流。

paragraphs.text: In Britain, the rewilding movement started by writer and environmental activist George Monbiot is popularly seen to seek the return of large camivores bears, wolves and lynx. In practice, it is retumning more modest herbivores like ponies and deer to the countryside. For decades, ecologists believed the end result of allowing a landscape to run wild would be dense forest and a mass extinction of sun-loving wild flowers and butterflies. But this belief has been demolished by Dutch ecologist Frans Vera. Since the 1980s, Vera has introduced wild cattle, horses and deer to rewilded marshland, and proved that 'natural' grazing creates a more dynamic landscape, a constantly changing pattern of open glades and wooded groves.
paragraphs.translation:
在英国，由作家兼环保活动家乔治·蒙比奥特发起的再野化运动普遍被认为旨在恢复大型食肉动物如熊、狼和猞猁的生存。
实际上，该运动正在将更温和的食草动物如小马和鹿重新引入乡村地区。
几十年来，生态学家曾认为让景观自然野化的最终结果将是茂密的森林以及喜阳野花和蝴蝶的大规模灭绝。
但这一观念已被荷兰生态学家弗兰斯·维拉推翻。
自20世纪80年代以来，维拉已将野牛、马和鹿引入再野化的沼泽地，并证明了“自然”放牧能形成更具活力的景观，即开阔林地与树木丛生的小树林不断变化的格局。

paragraphs.text: In the Scottish Highlands, rewilding is taking a different form as large landowners restore ancient pine forest. But David Balharry, former Scotland director of Rewilding Britain, cautions that rewilding in Scotland will only be championed by policymakers and politicians when it is led by local communities.
paragraphs.translation:
在苏格兰高地，随着大地主们恢复古老的松树林，再野化正呈现出不同的形式。
但“再野化英国”前苏格兰主任戴维·巴尔哈里警告说，只有当再野化由当地社区主导时，它才会得到政策制定者和政治家的支持。

paragraphs.text: For Burrell, rewilding has been a pragmatic way to revive the struggling family farm. Ecotourism there makes as much profit as his conventional farm did. Knepp's unproductive soil meant Burrell could not compete with globalised food production. His profits may be steady while conventional dairy and cattle farm incomes fall dramatically, but no farmers have yet followed his example.'It takes a new eye to look at this and say."that's beautiful", rather than go,"that's just a real mess",'says Burrell.'Other farmers may have a moral attitude towards it too-"why are you stopping food production?"Many criticise rewilding for abandoning productive farmland when the world's population is growing.
paragraphs.translation:
对于伯勒尔来说，再野化是重振陷入困境的家庭农场的一种务实方式。
那里的生态旅游所获利润与他传统农场的利润相当。
克内普贫瘠的土壤意味着伯勒尔无法与全球化的粮食生产竞争。
虽然传统奶牛场和养牛场收入急剧下降，但他的利润可能保持稳定，然而还没有农民效仿他的做法。
伯勒尔说：“需要用一种新的眼光来看待这件事，并说‘这很美’，而不是说‘这简直一团糟’。”
“其他农民可能对此也持有道德态度——‘你为什么要停止粮食生产？’”
许多人批评再野化在世界人口不断增长的情况下放弃了生产性农田。

paragraphs.text: Wouter Helmer, director of Rewilding Europe, sees no conflict between food production and rewilding: Europe is heading for a future of food produced more intensively in fewer areas, releasing less productive land for rewilding, he says.'Farming is being done by fewer and fewer farmers on a larger scale on the best soils. Theyleave the less profitable lands to become adventure land for an increasingly urban population.'
paragraphs.translation: 欧洲野化组织的主任Wouter Helmer认为粮食生产与野化之间并不冲突：他表示，欧洲未来的趋势是在更少的土地上以更集约的方式生产粮食，从而腾出生产力较低的土地用于野化。

paragraphs.text: Helmer says there is no point in seeking to feed the world with traditional organic farming because there is no one to do the labour: when he asks Dutch students who wants to farm, none raise their hands.'They have a completely different relationship to nature to their parents or grandparents. They are not fighting with it on a daily basis. On one hand they are disconnected from nature but on the other hand they are becoming more relaxed with nature-it's hunting and gathering but hunting with a camera and gathering experiences. The part of the countryside which is not used for intensive farming starts to serve all these new urban needs.'
paragraphs.translation:
赫尔默表示，试图通过传统有机农业来养活世界是没有意义的，因为没有人愿意从事这种劳动：当他问荷兰学生谁想务农时，没有人举手。
他们与自然的关系与他们的父母或祖父母完全不同。
他们不再每天与自然抗争。
一方面，他们与自然疏离，但另一方面，他们对自然变得更加放松——这是狩猎和采集，但用的是相机狩猎，收集的是经历。
乡村中未被用于集约化农业的部分开始满足所有这些新的城市需求。

paragraphs.text: Yet some environmentalists worry how rewilding connects with urban populations.'The challenge is how to make rewilding an issue that people in their ordinary lives can take action on,' says Elaine Gilligan of Friends of the Earth. She thinks it is great for engaging people in nature but doubts whether it is seen as important in large urban areas like Birmingham.
paragraphs.translation:
然而，一些环保主义者担心再野化如何与城市居民产生联系。
地球之友的伊莱恩·吉利根表示：“挑战在于如何让再野化成为人们在日常生活中能够采取行动的问题。”
她认为这能很好地促使人们参与自然，但怀疑这在伯明翰这样的城市大区是否被视为重要议题。

paragraphs.text: Rewilders argue that reducing flood risks for cities is one practical way rewilding can enhance urban life. Ted Green, founder president of the Ancient Tree Forum, believes that intensive farming can worsen flash flooding, and cause fertile earth to be swept downriver and out to sea.'The land may belong to the landowner but the soil must belong to the nation,'says Green.'When you see people cleaning out their houses after floods, you don't see them removing water, you see them removing mud. It's no longer an engineering problem-it's a farming problem."
paragraphs.translation:
再野生化倡导者认为，降低城市的洪水风险是再野生化改善城市生活的一个实际途径。
古树论坛创始主席泰德·格林认为，集约化农业可能加剧山洪暴发，并导致肥沃土壤被冲入下游河流直至大海。
‘土地可能属于地主，但土壤必须属于国家，’格林说道。
‘当你看到人们在洪水过后清理房屋时，你看到的不是他们清除积水，而是他们清除淤泥。
这不再是一个工程问题——而是一个农业问题。’

paragraphs.text: Some conservationists worry, however, that rewilding could replace the traditional protection of rare species on small nature reserves.'If rewilding really takes off, there's a risk people will say,"Oh we don't have to do any of that old stuff,"says Matt Shardlow, chief executive of Buglife.'But we still have habitat fragmentation and species in tiny places and we have to take care of them even if you have some areas made bigger for wildlife.'Whatever happens, we need more projects like Knepp.
paragraphs.translation:
然而，一些环保人士担心，再野化可能会取代小型自然保护区对珍稀物种的传统保护。
“如果再野化真正流行起来，人们可能会说‘哦，我们不必再做那些老一套了’，”Buglife的首席执行官马特·沙德洛说。
“但我们仍然面临栖息地破碎化和物种局限于狭小区域的问题，即使你为野生动物扩大了一些区域，我们也必须照顾好它们。”
无论发生什么，我们都需要更多像尼普这样的项目。

sentence_translations.sentence: Close to London's Gatwick Airport is Knepp Castle Estate, owned by Charlie Burrell.

sentence_translations.sentence: Linnartz says that many Dutch objected to 'nature development' 30 years ago but rewilding principles are now mainstream.
sentence_translations.translation: Linnartz表示，30年前许多荷兰人反对“自然开发”，但现在自然恢复原则已成为主流。

sentence_translations.sentence: In Britain, the rewilding movement started by writer and environmental activist George Monbiot is popularly seen to seek the return of large camivores bears, wolves and lynx.
sentence_translations.translation: 在英国，由作家兼环保活动家乔治·蒙比奥特发起的再野化运动普遍被认为旨在恢复大型食肉动物如熊、狼和猞猁的生存。

sentence_translations.sentence: In practice, it is retumning more modest herbivores like ponies and deer to the countryside.
sentence_translations.translation: 实际上，该运动正在将更温和的食草动物如小马和鹿重新引入乡村地区。

sentence_translations.sentence: For decades, ecologists believed the end result of allowing a landscape to run wild would be dense forest and a mass extinction of sun-loving wild flowers and butterflies.
sentence_translations.translation: 几十年来，生态学家曾认为让景观自然野化的最终结果将是茂密的森林以及喜阳野花和蝴蝶的大规模灭绝。

sentence_translations.sentence: But this belief has been demolished by Dutch ecologist Frans Vera.
sentence_translations.translation: 但这一观念已被荷兰生态学家弗兰斯·维拉推翻。

sentence_translations.sentence: Since the 1980s, Vera has introduced wild cattle, horses and deer to rewilded marshland, and proved that 'natural' grazing creates a more dynamic landscape, a constantly changing pattern of open glades and wooded groves.
sentence_translations.translation: 自20世纪80年代以来，维拉已将野牛、马和鹿引入再野化的沼泽地，并证明了“自然”放牧能形成更具活力的景观，即开阔林地与树木丛生的小树林不断变化的格局。

sentence_translations.sentence: In the Scottish Highlands, rewilding is taking a different form as large landowners restore ancient pine forest.
sentence_translations.translation: 在苏格兰高地，随着大地主们恢复古老的松树林，再野化正呈现出不同的形式。

sentence_translations.sentence: But David Balharry, former Scotland director of Rewilding Britain, cautions that rewilding in Scotland will only be championed by policymakers and politicians when it is led by local communities.
sentence_translations.translation: 但“再野化英国”前苏格兰主任戴维·巴尔哈里警告说，只有当再野化由当地社区主导时，它才会得到政策制定者和政治家的支持。

sentence_translations.sentence: For Burrell, rewilding has been a pragmatic way to revive the struggling family farm.
sentence_translations.translation: 对于伯勒尔来说，再野化是重振陷入困境的家庭农场的一种务实方式。

sentence_translations.sentence: Ecotourism there makes as much profit as his conventional farm did.
sentence_translations.translation: 那里的生态旅游所获利润与他传统农场的利润相当。

sentence_translations.sentence: Knepp's unproductive soil meant Burrell could not compete with globalised food production.
sentence_translations.translation: 克内普贫瘠的土壤意味着伯勒尔无法与全球化的粮食生产竞争。

sentence_translations.sentence: His profits may be steady while conventional dairy and cattle farm incomes fall dramatically, but no farmers have yet followed his example.
sentence_translations.translation: 虽然传统奶牛场和养牛场收入急剧下降，但他的利润可能保持稳定，然而还没有农民效仿他的做法。

sentence_translations.sentence: 'It takes a new eye to look at this and say, "that's beautiful", rather than go, "that's just a real mess",' says Burrell.
sentence_translations.translation: 伯勒尔说：“需要用一种新的眼光来看待这件事，并说‘这很美’，而不是说‘这简直一团糟’。”

sentence_translations.sentence: 'Other farmers may have a moral attitude towards it too - "why are you stopping food production?"
sentence_translations.translation: “其他农民可能对此也持有道德态度——‘你为什么要停止粮食生产？’”

sentence_translations.sentence: Many criticise rewilding for abandoning productive farmland when the world's population is growing.
sentence_translations.translation: 许多人批评再野化在世界人口不断增长的情况下放弃了生产性农田。

sentence_translations.sentence: Wouter Helmer, director of Rewilding Europe, sees no conflict between food production and rewilding: Europe is heading for a future of food produced more intensively in fewer areas, releasing less productive land for rewilding, he says.
sentence_translations.translation: 欧洲野化组织的主任Wouter Helmer认为粮食生产与野化之间并不冲突：他表示，欧洲未来的趋势是在更少的土地上以更集约的方式生产粮食，从而腾出生产力较低的土地用于野化。

sentence_translations.sentence: 'Farming is being done by fewer and fewer farmers on a larger scale on the best soils. They leave the less profitable lands to become adventure land for an increasingly urban population.'
sentence_translations.translation: “农业正由越来越少的农民在最优质的土壤上进行大规模经营。他们将利润较低的土地留给日益城市化的居民，成为他们的探险之地。”

sentence_translations.sentence: Helmer says there is no point in seeking to feed the world with traditional organic farming because there is no one to do the labour: when he asks Dutch students who wants to farm, none raise their hands.
sentence_translations.translation: 赫尔默表示，试图通过传统有机农业来养活世界是没有意义的，因为没有人愿意从事这种劳动：当他问荷兰学生谁想务农时，没有人举手。

sentence_translations.sentence: They have a completely different relationship to nature to their parents or grandparents.
sentence_translations.translation: 他们与自然的关系与他们的父母或祖父母完全不同。

sentence_translations.sentence: They are not fighting with it on a daily basis.
sentence_translations.translation: 他们不再每天与自然抗争。

sentence_translations.sentence: On one hand they are disconnected from nature but on the other hand they are becoming more relaxed with nature-it's hunting and gathering but hunting with a camera and gathering experiences.
sentence_translations.translation: 一方面，他们与自然疏离，但另一方面，他们对自然变得更加放松——这是狩猎和采集，但用的是相机狩猎，收集的是经历。

sentence_translations.sentence: The part of the countryside which is not used for intensive farming starts to serve all these new urban needs.
sentence_translations.translation: 乡村中未被用于集约化农业的部分开始满足所有这些新的城市需求。

sentence_translations.sentence: Yet some environmentalists worry how rewilding connects with urban populations.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，一些环保主义者担心再野化如何与城市居民产生联系。

sentence_translations.sentence: 'The challenge is how to make rewilding an issue that people in their ordinary lives can take action on,' says Elaine Gilligan of Friends of the Earth.
sentence_translations.translation: 地球之友的伊莱恩·吉利根表示：“挑战在于如何让再野化成为人们在日常生活中能够采取行动的问题。”

sentence_translations.sentence: She thinks it is great for engaging people in nature but doubts whether it is seen as important in large urban areas like Birmingham.
sentence_translations.translation: 她认为这能很好地促使人们参与自然，但怀疑这在伯明翰这样的城市大区是否被视为重要议题。

sentence_translations.sentence: Rewilders argue that reducing flood risks for cities is one practical way rewilding can enhance urban life.
sentence_translations.translation: 再野生化倡导者认为，降低城市的洪水风险是再野生化改善城市生活的一个实际途径。

sentence_translations.sentence: Ted Green, founder president of the Ancient Tree Forum, believes that intensive farming can worsen flash flooding, and cause fertile earth to be swept downriver and out to sea.
sentence_translations.translation: 古树论坛创始主席泰德·格林认为，集约化农业可能加剧山洪暴发，并导致肥沃土壤被冲入下游河流直至大海。

sentence_translations.sentence: 'The land may belong to the landowner but the soil must belong to the nation,'says Green.
sentence_translations.translation: ‘土地可能属于地主，但土壤必须属于国家，’格林说道。

sentence_translations.sentence: 'When you see people cleaning out their houses after floods, you don't see them removing water, you see them removing mud.
sentence_translations.translation: ‘当你看到人们在洪水过后清理房屋时，你看到的不是他们清除积水，而是他们清除淤泥。

sentence_translations.sentence: It's no longer an engineering problem-it's a farming problem."
sentence_translations.translation: 这不再是一个工程问题——而是一个农业问题。’

sentence_translations.sentence: Some conservationists worry, however, that rewilding could replace the traditional protection of rare species on small nature reserves.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，一些环保人士担心，再野化可能会取代小型自然保护区对珍稀物种的传统保护。

sentence_translations.sentence: 'If rewilding really takes off, there's a risk people will say,"Oh we don't have to do any of that old stuff,"says Matt Shardlow, chief executive of Buglife.
sentence_translations.translation: “如果再野化真正流行起来，人们可能会说‘哦，我们不必再做那些老一套了’，”Buglife的首席执行官马特·沙德洛说。

sentence_translations.sentence: 'But we still have habitat fragmentation and species in tiny places and we have to take care of them even if you have some areas made bigger for wildlife.'
sentence_translations.translation: “但我们仍然面临栖息地破碎化和物种局限于狭小区域的问题，即使你为野生动物扩大了一些区域，我们也必须照顾好它们。”

sentence_translations.sentence: Whatever happens, we need more projects like Knepp.
sentence_translations.translation: 无论发生什么，我们都需要更多像尼普这样的项目。
